summary.text: Maureen Mooney is a Republican state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 12 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2020 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is an education administrator and an attorney by training who also served in the House from 2002 to 2008.

paragraphs.text: Maureen Mooney lives in Merrimack, New Hampshire.

She earned a B.A. in political science from The Thomas More College of Liberal Arts in 1997, a J.D. from the Massachusetts School of Law in 2000, and an M.Ed. in educational leadership from New England College in 2015.
Her career experience includes working as an associate dean with the Massachusetts School of Law and in administration with a charter school.
Mooney served in the New Hampshire House from 2002 to 2008, returned in 2020, and has represented Hillsborough 12 since the 2022 election, according to Ballotpedia.
She was assigned to the Election Law Committee for the 2021-2022 session and to the House Finance Committee, as vice chair of its Division III, for the 2023-2024 session.
